svg.text: Cache about to go cold: The prompt cache goes cold in 5m. A send
before then reads the 200k tokens for $0.04; after, it re-writes
them on Opus 5.5 for $1.60. Leaving for longer? /route away
Each request re-sends the whole conversation. A warm prompt cache lets the API read it back cheaply,
at a tenth of the input price or less. The cache expires after the TTL; the first send after that
writes everything again, at 1.25-2× input. /clear and start from a short note, or come back in time.

text.tspan: The cache had expired after 1h12m idle, so this send re-wrote 200k tokens on Opus 5.5

svg.text: for $1.60; read warm they would have cost $0.04.
